claims.claim: The launcher can select TerranRaynor and emit a bounded generated plan without launching SC2.
The generated composition is not valid for runtime acceptance because its plan schema, dependency closure, and document roundtrip checks fail.
A real launch before plan remediation would produce ambiguous evidence and risk live-content races.

validation.summary: Launcher configs passed and the Raynor plan was generated.
Four null transitive package paths violate the schema.
DataCenter, dependency closure, and document roundtrip failed; Galaxy was partial.
